_comment: Mutations that remove the guarantees of the Managed AUTO-RENEWAL
(owner decision 2026-11-06).
The payment provider has NO provider-side recurring, so WE issue the
next 30-day invoice ourselves: invoice N is paid -> the plan extends ->
invoice N+1 is issued -> ...
A removes the renewal entirely (the webhook stops issuing the next
invoice). B removes the IDEMPOTENCY GUARD, so a replayed confirmation
issues a SECOND invoice for the same period. C removes the
Managed-only restriction, so every tier starts renewing. D removes the
'the tier must still be ACTIVE' guard, so a tier that has been switched
off still gets invoiced. E replaces the CURRENT effective price with the
tier's headline price, so a repriced tier is renewed at the old price.
F breaks the order_id -> payment -> customer mapping the provider's
webhook uses to resolve the invoice back to the customer. G drops a
failed renewal from ERROR to INFO, so a customer who is NOT invoiced
becomes invisible in the logs.
Every one of these must be KILLED by tests/test_managed_auto_renew.py.
Run with:  python tools/mutation_harness.py tools/mutations/managed_auto_renew.json
NEVER run concurrently with a test run or tools/review_fanout.py -- both will
read a file that is mid-mutation and report on code that does not exist.

mutations.label: A: the paid Managed period never issues its renewal invoice
mutations.needle:
await issue_renewal_invoice(db, payment=payment, user=user)
        except Exception as exc:
mutations.replace:
pass  # MUTANT: the renewal invoice is never issued
        except Exception as exc:

mutations.label: B: the idempotency guard is removed, so a replayed event issues a second invoice
C: every tier renews, not just the Managed one
D: a tier that has been switched off is still invoiced
mutations.needle:
if not plan_config or not plan_config.get("active", False):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Plan not found or is not active.")
mutations.replace:
if False:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Plan not found or is not active.")

mutations.label: E: the renewal is charged at the tier's headline price instead of the current effective price
F: the renewal invoice's order_id no longer resolves back to the customer
G: a renewal that could not be issued is logged below ERROR
mutations.needle:
logger.error(
            "Failed to issue the renewal invoice for customer %s on tier '%s': %s",
            user.id,
            payment.plan_name,
            exc.detail,
mutations.replace:
logger.info(
            "Failed to issue the renewal invoice for customer %s on tier '%s': %s",
            user.id,
            payment.plan_name,
            exc.detail,
